annotations.title: Is this moment lasting, or past its peak?

description: Use when the user is writing a creative or campaign brief, or weighing a trend, and asks whether a moment, ingredient, format or cultural theme is a lasting shift or a fad that has peaked. Returns, for US Google Trends and English Wikipedia interest since 2016, how much of its best 12 months the subject keeps today, with controls, with months since the peak and a verdict: lasting, fading, past its peak, still rising, or signals disagree. Ratios and dates only. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line.
